verdicts.reason: A works as a banner. The large headline is set left with good margins and the cat illustration is anchored at the bottom right, so it reads left to right. Its flaws are small: the cat group is a bit small, which leaves a slightly loose gap between the text and the cats. B shrinks the headline, so it loses dominance, and jams it against the left edge. The cat group floats in from the right, leaving about 130px of empty purple on the right side, so the layout feels lopsided and arbitrary.
